_readme: ComfyUI workflow templates (API format), grounded against the live /object_info of ComfyUI 0.27.1 on 2026-07-10 (updated from 0.24.0 for krea2 support; all 10 templates revalidated PASS-with-note). ComfyClient patches nodes by _meta.title using the 'patchable' maps below (title -> node_id.input_field). Every template must pass `model_lab test-workflows` after any node-pack change. 2026-07-11: the 5 SDXL templates (scene_plate, panel_txt2img, panel_img2img_lastframe, character_sheet, mouth_sheet) no longer ship PATCH_ checkpoint/LoRA placeholders - CKPT now defaults to animagine-xl-4.0.safetensors (downloaded into models/checkpoints/; a non-banned SDXL anime base, cagliostrolab/animagine-xl-4.0), LORA_SPEED to the real Hyper-SDXL-8steps-CFG-lora.safetensors (already on disk), and every LORA_STYLE/LORA_CHAR*/LORA_CHAR slot with no trained LoRA yet defaults to that same Hyper file at strength 0.0/0.0 (harmless no-op placeholder - a real file resolves in the UI, but it applies zero effect) - see each template's per-node _meta.note. MODEL BAN LIST is unchanged and still forbids NoobAI-XL-v1.1, wai-illustrious-v110, z-anime-distill, FLUX.1-Krea-dev; animagine-xl-4.0 is not on that list. ltx_ambient/ltx_director: CKPT_LTX repointed from the never-present ltx-video-2b-v0.9.5.safetensors to ltx-2.3-22b-dev-fp8.safetensors (symlinked into models/checkpoints/ from the external SSD) purely for UI resolution - it is a different LTX generation than the 2B-era nodes in these templates and is very likely unusable on 8GB VRAM; do not test-render.

scene_plate.json.purpose: One location master plate per scene (no characters) - the background consistency anchor
scene_plate.json.notes: 2026-07-11: CKPT defaults to animagine-xl-4.0.safetensors; LORA_STYLE defaults to Hyper-SDXL-8steps-CFG-lora.safetensors at strength 0 (no style LoRA trained yet).

panel_txt2img.json.purpose: Per-shot panel: base + speed LoRA + style LoRA + <=2 character LoRAs + dual IPAdapter (char ref, scene plate)
panel_txt2img.json.notes: Disable an unused char LoRA by patching its strengths to 0. Disable plate conditioning by patching IPA_PLATE_WEIGHT to 0. 2026-07-11: CKPT defaults to animagine-xl-4.0.safetensors; LORA_STYLE/LORA_CHAR_1/LORA_CHAR_2 default to Hyper-SDXL-8steps-CFG-lora.safetensors at strength 0 (no style/character LoRAs trained yet).

panel_img2img_lastframe.json.purpose: Block-opening shot conditioned on previous block's last frame (composition continuity)
panel_img2img_lastframe.json.notes: 2026-07-11: CKPT defaults to animagine-xl-4.0.safetensors; LORA_STYLE/LORA_CHAR_1/LORA_CHAR_2 default to Hyper-SDXL-8steps-CFG-lora.safetensors at strength 0 (no style/character LoRAs trained yet).

character_sheet.json.purpose: 360-degree turnaround / expression / pose reference frames (Stage 1R). VIEW instruction goes inside PROMPT_POS.
character_sheet.json.notes: Uses il_anime_model_turn LoRA (SDXL-family). If krea2 is a different architecture, M4 must retrain/replace this LoRA - see design 5.3b. 2026-07-11: CKPT defaults to animagine-xl-4.0.safetensors; LORA_CHAR defaults to Hyper-SDXL-8steps-CFG-lora.safetensors at strength 0 (no character LoRA trained yet).

mouth_sheet.json.purpose: Inpaint the mouth region of a character's front ref into one viseme shape (run 9x per character)
mouth_sheet.json.notes: Pipeline pre-renders the mask PNG (white mouth bbox on black) and uploads both images. 2026-07-11: CKPT defaults to animagine-xl-4.0.safetensors; LORA_CHAR defaults to Hyper-SDXL-8steps-CFG-lora.safetensors at strength 0 (original design strength was 0.9 for real identity-lock - restore once a real per-character LoRA is trained).

ltx_ambient.json.purpose: Tier-1 ambient motion: image-to-video from the shot panel, core ComfyUI LTX nodes
ltx_ambient.json.notes: FPS patched into both LTXVConditioning.frame_rate and SaveAnimatedWEBP.fps; RIFE conforms to project fps afterwards. 2026-07-10: no LTX 2B checkpoint bundles a text encoder (verified via safetensors headers - all are model+vae only), so a CLIPLoader node (id 20, title T5_ENCODER, type ltxv, clip_name t5xxl_fp8_e4m3fn.safetensors) feeds CLIP to nodes 2/3; node 1 (CheckpointLoaderSimple) still supplies MODEL+VAE. 2026-07-11: ltx-video-2b-v0.9.5.safetensors was never actually present on disk (missing-model in the UI); CKPT_LTX now defaults to ltx-2.3-22b-dev-fp8.safetensors, symlinked into models/checkpoints/ from the external SSD. This is purely to make the template resolve cleanly in the browser - the 22B model is a different LTX generation than these 2B-era nodes were built for and is very likely unusable on 8GB VRAM. Do NOT test-render this template.

ltx_director.json.purpose: Tier-2 action motion with first+last frame conditioning (LTXVAddGuide at frame_idx -1)
ltx_director.json.notes: Same T5 wiring as ltx_ambient (2026-07-10): CLIPLoader node 20 (title T5_ENCODER, type ltxv, t5xxl_fp8_e4m3fn.safetensors) feeds CLIP to nodes 2/3; node 1 supplies MODEL+VAE only. 2026-07-11: ltx-video-2b-v0.9.5.safetensors was never actually present on disk; CKPT_LTX now defaults to ltx-2.3-22b-dev-fp8.safetensors, symlinked into models/checkpoints/ from the external SSD, purely for UI resolution - very likely unusable on 8GB VRAM. Do NOT test-render this template.

video_i2v_ltx_2b.json.purpose: Tier-1/2 primary: LTX-2 2B image-to-video (ltxv-2b-0.9.8-distilled-fp8-i2v, self-contained on 8GB VRAM). 768x448x81f@16fps.
video_i2v_ltx_2b.json.notes: The verified 2B LTX path (video_router._DEFAULT_TEMPLATE; proof render frames delta ~94 on 8GB, smoke gate .ltx_smoke_passed). Native graph: CheckpointLoaderSimple(ltxv-2b-0.9.8) -> LTXVScheduler(6) + CLIPLoader T5(2, type ltxv) -> CLIPTextEncode POS(4)/NEG(5) -> LTXVConditioning(53); LoadImage(50) START_FRAME -> LTXVImgToVideo(52) -> SamplerCustomAdvanced with RandomNoise(7, noise_seed) + CFGGuider(9); VAEDecode(11) -> VHS_VideoCombine(12) h264-mp4. FPS patched into LTXVConditioning.frame_rate (53) AND VHS_VideoCombine.frame_rate (12).

hunyuan_i2v.json.purpose: HunyuanVideo image-to-video (5B/13B, GGUF Q4_K_M 7.9GB on 8GB VRAM). 848x480x53f default.
hunyuan_i2v.json.notes: Native ComfyUI Hunyuan I2V graph: UnetLoaderGGUF(hunyuan-video-i2v-720p-Q4_K_M.gguf,1) -> DualCLIPLoader(clip_l+llava_llama3_fp8_scaled,2) + CLIPVisionLoader(llava_llama3_vision,3) -> CLIPVisionEncode(6); TextEncodeHunyuanVideo_ImageToVideo(7) -> HunyuanImageToVideo(8, v1 concat) -> ModelSamplingSD3(9, shift7) -> FluxGuidance(10, 6) -> BasicGuider(11); BasicScheduler(14, simple x20) + KSamplerSelect(13, euler) + RandomNoise(12); SamplerCustomAdvanced(15) -> VAEDecodeTiled(16) -> ImageFromBatch(17, skip 4 bad frames) -> SaveWEBM(18) vp9.

wan_ti2v.json.purpose: Tier-2 alternate: Wan2.2-TI2V-5B (Q4_K_M GGUF), 20 steps unipc, block-swap 20, cfg 5.0, 81f@16fps, image-to-video from START_FRAME
wan_ti2v.json.notes: Rebuilt 2026-08-20 after the channel-mismatch root cause: the Wan 2.2 5B is t2v (NO image cross-attention, model_type='t2v' in the loader) and the Wan 2.2 VAE is WanVideoVAE38 (48-ch latent, upsampling_factor=16). The old graph fed WanVideoImageToVideoEncode (channel-concat I2V path) which produced 48ch noise + 48ch image_cond = 96ch vs the 48-ch patch embed -> error. Correct wiring (matches official example_workflows/wanvideo_2_2_5B_I2V_example_WIP.json): LoadImage(6) -> ImageResizeKJv2(7, WIDTH/HEIGHT, stretch, divisible_by 16) -> WanVideoEncode(8, plain VAE encode) -> WanVideoEmptyEmbeds(12, num_frames=FRAMES, extra_latents from WanVideoEncode) -> WanVideoSampler(9, image_embeds from WanVideoEmptyEmbeds, t2v path, prefix-frame injection). On-disk weights: WanVideoModelLoader model 'Wan2.2-TI2V-5B-Q4_K_M.gguf', umt5-xxl-enc-bf16 T5, Wan2_2_VAE_bf16. Block-swap 20 via WanVideoBlockSwap -> loader.block_swap_args. PROMPT_NEG shares the MOTION_PROMPT node (WanVideoTextEncode carries positive+negative on one node) so it is patched by node-id. WIDTH/HEIGHT patch the resize node (7); FRAMES patches EmptyEmbeds.num_frames (12); output fps lives on VHS_VideoCombine (11). Gate: .wan_smoke_passed, must be earned by a real render.

panel_txt2img_krea.json.purpose: krea2 (Krea-2-Turbo) primary-model txt2img panel. Native ComfyUI Krea2 graph, NOT SDXL/FLUX-style. Distinct arch: 12B Diffusion Transformer (Krea2Transformer2DModel) + Qwen3-VL-4B text encoder + Qwen-Image VAE (AutoencoderKLQwenImage, 16-ch latent).
panel_txt2img_krea.json.notes: Built 2026-07-10 from the authoritative Krea-2-Turbo model card + the official native ComfyUI workflow (vantagewithai/Krea-2-Turbo-GGUF) + the calcuis gguf-org workflow. Graph: UnetLoaderGGUF(krea2_turbo-Q4_K_S.gguf) -> KSampler; CLIPLoader(qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors, type='krea2') -> CLIPTextEncode(POS); negative is ConditioningZeroOut of POS (Turbo is CFG-distilled: KSampler cfg=1.0, so a text negative has no effect - matches the official workflow, PROMPT_NEG carries no patchable text); VAELoader(qwen_image_vae.safetensors); EmptySD3LatentImage gives the 16-channel latent the Qwen-Image VAE needs (NOT EmptyLatentImage). Sampler: euler/simple, 8 steps, cfg 1.0, denoise 1.0 (per model card: steps 8, guidance 0.0). UNBLOCKED 2026-07-10: ComfyUI updated 0.24.0 -> 0.27.1 (torch/pydantic pins held); 'krea2' now in the live CLIPLoader type enum. Proof render passed same day: 1216x704, 8 steps, 113.7s wall, peak VRAM 7782 MiB under --novram, output clean (see docs/planning/krea2-lab-report.md). LoRA stacking + reference/IPAdapter conditioning for this arch are M4 scope (krea2 has its own LoRA format + krea2 identity-edit/style-reference, NOT SDXL IPAdapter).

image_krea2.json.purpose: Mandated primary (design 5.3b): krea2 (Krea-2-Turbo) GGUF Q4_K_S txt2img. pipeline/image_router.py routes here only after confirming krea2_turbo-Q4_K_S.gguf is fully on disk in ComfyUI/models/unet/; otherwise stages fall back to image_flux_fallback.json.
image_krea2.json.notes: Simplified single-purpose sibling of panel_txt2img_krea.json: same validated graph (UnetLoaderGGUF -> CLIPLoader(type=krea2, qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors) -> CLIPTextEncode -> ConditioningZeroOut negative -> EmptySD3LatentImage -> KSampler euler/simple 8-step cfg1.0 -> VAEDecode(qwen_image_vae.safetensors) -> SaveImage), collapsed onto the flux-fallback node-id layout (1/2/3/11/12/13/14/15/16) so stage code can route between the two templates by name alone. No LoRA/IPAdapter path yet -- krea2 uses its own LoRA format + identity/style-reference conditioning, M4 scope (same caveat as panel_txt2img_krea.json).

lora_dataset_prep.json.purpose: WD14 captioning of one ref image for LoRA datasets (pipeline loops it over a ref folder)
lora_dataset_prep.json.notes: Built 2026-07-09 against the installed WD14Tagger|pysssss node. Graph: LoadImage (INPUT_IMAGE) -> WD14Tagger (TAGGER; model wd-v1-4-moat-tagger-v2, threshold 0.35). WD14Tagger is an OUTPUT node: after queueing, the pipeline polls GET /history/<prompt_id> and reads outputs['2']['tags'] (the comma-joined tag string) - there is no SaveText node. Per-image (not folder) by design; design 5.3b's 'INPUT_DIR' title is superseded - the pipeline patches INPUT_IMAGE per file and injects the outfit token into the caption txt after tagging. TAGGER_MODEL/TAGGER_THRESHOLD share the TAGGER node so they patch by node-id.

image_txt2img_flux_fallback.json.purpose: Universal fallback image generation via flux-2-klein-4b GGUF (design 5.3b fallback chain; 2026-08 swap from flux1-schnell). Used for plates, refs, and panels while krea2 is absent or its gate hasn't passed. klein recipe: UnetLoaderGGUF(flux-2-klein-4b-Q4_K_M.gguf) -> CLIPLoader(qwen_3_4b.safetensors, type flux2) -> CLIPTextEncode POS/NEG -> EmptyFlux2LatentImage + Flux2Scheduler(20 steps) -> KSamplerSelect(euler) + RandomNoise + CFGGuider(cfg 5) -> SamplerCustomAdvanced -> VAEDecode(flux2-vae) -> SaveImage. WIDTH/HEIGHT patch both the latent AND Flux2Scheduler (resolution-dependent sigma schedule).

char_ref_character_sheet_flux.json.purpose: Character sheet reference generation via flux-2-klein-4b GGUF (design 5.3b + AGENTS.md model table). 360-degree turnaround / expression / pose reference frames (Stage 1R); VIEW instruction goes inside PROMPT_POS.
char_ref_character_sheet_flux.json.notes: Rebuilt 2026-08 for the FLUX.2 klein recipe (qwen_3_4b + flux2-vae); replaces the flux1 clip_l/t5xxl + ae.safetensors graph.

image_flux_fallback.json.purpose: Universal fallback image generation via flux-2-klein-4b GGUF (design 5.3b fallback chain). Identical graph to image_txt2img_flux_fallback.json (kept as the registered alias).
image_flux_fallback.json.notes: 2026-08: rebuilt for the FLUX.2 klein recipe (qwen_3_4b text encoder + flux2-vae + EmptyFlux2LatentImage + Flux2Scheduler + CFGGuider 5 + SamplerCustomAdvanced).

image_txt2img_krea2.json.purpose: Mandated primary (design 5.3b): krea2 (Krea-2-Turbo) GGUF Q4_K_S txt2img. pipeline/image_router.py routes here only after confirming krea2_turbo-Q4_K_S.gguf is fully on disk in ComfyUI/models/unet/; otherwise stages fall back to image_flux_fallback.json.
image_txt2img_krea2.json.notes: Simplified single-purpose sibling of panel_txt2img_krea.json: same validated graph (UnetLoaderGGUF -> CLIPLoader(type=krea2, qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors) -> CLIPTextEncode -> ConditioningZeroOut negative -> EmptySD3LatentImage -> KSampler euler/simple 8-step cfg1.0 -> VAEDecode(qwen_image_vae.safetensors) -> SaveImage), collapsed onto the flux-fallback node-id layout (1/2/3/11/12/13/14/15/16) so stage code can route between the two templates by name alone. No LoRA/IPAdapter path yet -- krea2 uses its own LoRA format + identity/style-reference conditioning, M4 scope (same caveat as panel_txt2img_krea.json).

video_i2v_ltx_23b_tiled.json.purpose: LTX-2.3 22B distilled (Q4_K_M) i2v, tiled sampler + spatiotemporal tiled VAE decode. Tier-2 director path on 8GB VRAM.

wan_i2v_21.json.purpose: Wan2.1-I2V-14B-480P (Q4_K_M GGUF), true i2v channel-concat path, 20 steps unipc, block-swap 16, cfg 5.0, 81f@16fps, image-to-video from START_FRAME
wan_i2v_21.json.notes: Added 2026-08-20 for the I2V shootout. The 14B 480P is a TRUE i2v model (loader detects 'blocks.0.cross_attn.k_img.weight' -> model_type='i2v', 16-ch latent, out_dim=16), so it uses the channel-concat WanVideoImageToVideoEncode path (mask+encoded image+noise), NOT the 5B prefix-frame path. Wiring matches official example_workflows/wanvideo_2_1_14B_I2V_example_03.json: LoadImage(6) -> ImageResizeKJv2(7, WIDTH/HEIGHT, stretch, divisible_by 16) -> WanVideoImageToVideoEncode(8, FRAMES, start_image from resize, width/height from resize outputs, vae, fun_or_fl2v_model=false) -> WanVideoSampler(9, image_embeds from 8). VAE Wan2_1_VAE_bf16 (16ch, upsampling 8). On-disk: wan2.1-i2v-14b-480p-Q4_K_M.gguf (11.34GB, HF city96/Wan2.1-I2V-14B-480P-gguf), umt5_xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled T5, Wan2_1_VAE_bf16. Block-swap 16 (14B has 40 layers; example set 10). PROMPT_NEG shares node 4. START_FRAME patches LoadImage.image; WIDTH/HEIGHT patch resize node 7; FRAMES patches node 8; output fps on VHS_VideoCombine (11). Gate: .wan21_smoke_passed.

video_svd.json.purpose: SVD (Stable Video Diffusion) img2vid via ComfyUI-native nodes (ImageOnlyCheckpointLoader + SVD_img2vid_Conditioning + VideoLinearCFGGuidance), fp16 single-file from HF becausecurious/stable-video-diffusion-img2vid-fp16
video_svd.json.notes: Added 2026-08-20 for the I2V shootout. SVD is NOT a WanVideoWrapper model - it uses ComfyUI core: ImageOnlyCheckpointLoader(1) -> MODEL/CLIP_VISION/VAE; LoadImage(2) -> ImageResizeKJv2(3, WIDTH/HEIGHT, stretch, divisible_by 8) -> SVD_img2vid_Conditioning(4, clip_vision from loader, init_image from resize, vae from loader, video_frames=FRAMES, motion_bucket_id, fps=6); VideoLinearCFGGuidance(5, min_cfg 1.0) -> KSampler(6, SEED/STEPS/CFG, euler/simple, denoise 1.0) -> VAEDecode(7) -> VHS_VideoCombine(8, frame_rate). Base fp16 = 14 frames (svd-fp16), XT = 25 frames (svd_xt-fp16). motion_bucket_id 127 = default moderate motion. Gate: .svd_smoke_passed.

wan_ti2v_2f.json.purpose: Wan2.2-TI2V-5B Q4_K_M with FIRST+LAST frame conditioning (2 high-quality keyframes). Start frame injected at latent index 0 (prefix), end frame injected at latent index -1 via WanVideoAddExtraLatent. Conservative 672x384, 33f, 14 steps, cfg 2.5 (2026-08-20 tuning for grain/shake reduction).
wan_ti2v_2f.json.notes: Built 2026-08-20 in response to grainy/shaky single-frame Wan clips. Two-keyframe conditioning pins both endpoints so the model interpolates instead of drifting -> less grain, less jitter. Wiring: LoadImage(6 START_FRAME) -> ImageResizeKJv2(7 WIDTH/HEIGHT) -> WanVideoEncode(8) -> WanVideoEmptyEmbeds(12, FRAMES, extra_latents=start) -> WanVideoAddExtraLatent(13, END_INJECT, latent_index=-1, extra_latents=end) -> WanVideoSampler(14). End frame: LoadImage(9 END_FRAME) -> ImageResizeKJv2(10, width/height from 7) -> WanVideoEncode(11). Sampler resolves negative latent_index against noise length (last latent position = end frame). On-disk: Wan2.2-TI2V-5B-Q4_K_M.gguf, umt5-xxl-enc-bf16 T5, Wan2_2_VAE_bf16. PROMPT_NEG shares node 4. CFG on 14.cfg. Gate: .wan22_2f_smoke_passed.

end_frame_flux_klein.json.purpose: Flux-2-Klein img2img END-FRAME generator: takes the START panel + motion prompt and produces a consistent next-moment frame for Wan 2.2 TI2V two-keyframe conditioning. Uses the flux2 klein recipe (qwen_3_4b text encoder, flux2-vae, KSampler denoise 0.55).
end_frame_flux_klein.json.notes: Built 2026-08-20 for the Wan 2.2 first+last-frame workflow (wan_ti2v_2f.json). The END frame must be a high-quality Flux-2-Klein render consistent with the START frame (same character/outfit/scene, slightly progressed moment) so Wan interpolates between two pinned endpoints instead of drifting from one. Wiring: LoadImage(4 START_FRAME) -> ImageResizeKJv2(5 WIDTH/HEIGHT) -> VAEEncode(6) -> KSampler(9, SEED/STEPS/CFG/DENOISE, denoise 0.55) -> VAEDecode(10) -> SaveImage(11). Prompt PATCH_PROMPT drives the 'next moment'. Gate: .wan22_2f_smoke_passed.

panel_i2i_flux_klein.json.purpose: Flux-2-Klein image-to-image panel edit (ReferenceLatent + KSampler denoise). Source panel is VAE-encoded and used both as the img2img latent and as ReferenceLatent conditioning so characters + background stay consistent while the prompt advances the moment. The i2i basis for the Wan 2.2 first+last-frame chained-panel workflow.
panel_i2i_flux_klein.json.notes: Built 2026-08-20 for the consistent-panel Wan chaining logic (panel1 = first_shot1 -> final_shot1; panel2 = final_shot1 -> final_shot2). Uses core ReferenceLatent (available, unlike the imported workflow's custom ed29e010 node). Source image (previous panel) -> ImageResizeKJv2 -> VAEEncode -> ReferenceLatent(conditioning) + KSampler(denoise 0.55, same latent). Negative blocks character/background/count drift. On-disk: flux-2-klein-4b-Q4_K_M.gguf, qwen_3_4b text encoder, flux2-vae. Gate: .flux2_i2i_smoke_passed.

panel_ref_flux_klein.json.purpose: Flux-2-Klein per-panel character-reference conditioning. Renders a panel conditioned on BOTH the shot character's reference image (char_ref_character_sheet_flux output from stage1r) AND the scene plate, via two chained core ReferenceLatent nodes, so the character stays on-model and the background stays on-scene. Addresses LTX/Wan face + character-design distortion caused by under-conditioned source panels.
panel_ref_flux_klein.json.notes: Built 2026-08-20 for stage3b per-panel identity lock (test 1). Wiring: LoadImage(4 CHAR_REF) -> ImageResizeKJv2(5 WIDTH/HEIGHT) -> VAEEncode(6); LoadImage(20 PLATE) -> ImageResizeKJv2(21) -> VAEEncode(22); CLIPTextEncode(7 POS/8 NEG); ReferenceLatent(9 REF_CHAR on 6) -> ReferenceLatent(23 REF_PLATE on 22) -> KSampler(10, positive=23, latent_image=22 plate, denoise 0.62) -> VAEDecode(11) -> SaveImage(12). Denoise < 1 keeps the plate background while the char ref locks identity. Uses flux-2-klein-4b-Q4_K_M.gguf + qwen_3_4b + flux2-vae (all on disk, 8GB-safe). Gate: .flux2_ref_smoke_passed.

video_i2v_ltx_23b_8gb.json.purpose: LTX-2.3 22B (Q4_K_M GGUF) non-tiled sampler + TILED VAE decode for 8GB VRAM. Avoids the buggy LTXVTiledSampler (v2 custom-node calling SamplerCustomAdvanced().sample() which doesn't exist on the v3 core node -> None-latent crash). Uses core SamplerCustomAdvanced + LTXVImgToVideo + LTXVSpatioTemporalTiledVAEDecode. Per user recommendation: enable Tiled VAE Decode to prevent OOM on final render pass.
video_i2v_ltx_23b_8gb.json.notes: Built 2026-08-20 (option 1 after option 2 confirmed dead end). LTXVTiledSampler crashes with 'NoneType has no attribute shape' because ComfyUI-LTXVideo/tiled_sampler.py:268 calls SamplerCustomAdvanced().sample() but SamplerCustomAdvanced is a v3 io.ComfyNode with only execute(). This 8GB template uses the working non-tiled path: UnetLoaderGGUF(1) -> DualCLIPLoaderGGUF(2 gemma-3 + ltx2.3 proj) -> VAELoaderKJ(3 LTX23 vae) -> CLIPTextEncode(4/5) -> LTXVConditioning(53) -> LTXVImgToVideo(52, WIDTH/HEIGHT/FRAMES/STRENGTH, img2video cond + latent) -> LTXVScheduler(6 STEPS) -> KSamplerSelect(8 euler_ancestral_cfg_pp) -> CFGGuider(9) -> SamplerCustomAdvanced(10) -> LTXVSpatioTemporalTiledVAEDecode(11, tiled decode to avoid OOM) -> VHS_VideoCombine(12). 768x448x97f@24fps, 8 steps distilled. Gate: .ltx23_8gb_smoke_passed.

video_i2v_ltx_23b_8gb_flf.json.purpose: LTX-2.3 22B first+last-frame conditioning (non-tiled sampler + tiled VAE decode) for 8GB. Loads a 33-frame image sequence (first frame at 0, last at 32) via LoadImagesFromFolderKJ and feeds it to LTXVImgToVideo so motion interpolates between two consistent keyframes. steps=8, strength=0.06.
video_i2v_ltx_23b_8gb_flf.json.notes: Built 2026-08-20. Same working non-tiled path as video_i2v_ltx_23b_8gb.json but with a frame-sequence input for first+last-frame conditioning. LoadImagesFromFolderKJ(50 SEQ_FOLDER, stretch to WIDTHxHEIGHT) -> LTXVImgToVideo(52, image=sequence, strength 0.06) -> LTXVScheduler(6 steps 8) -> SamplerCustomAdvanced(10) -> LTXVSpatioTemporalTiledVAEDecode(11) -> VHS(12). Scheduler shifts 2.05/0.95 (LTX-2.3 correct). Gate: .ltx23_8gb_smoke_passed.

ltx_director_23.json.purpose: LTX-2.3 22B LTXDirector video-to-video director (timeline: image start frame + text beats + optional motion video segment + IC-LoRA) for 8GB. Reuses the proven 8GB model stack (UnetLoaderGGUF Q4_K_M + gemma-3 Q3_K_XL dual clip + LTX23 video VAE) with LTXVChunkFeedForward VRAM chunking, then LTXDirector -> ConditioningZeroOut/LTXVConditioning -> LTXDirectorGuide -> CFGGuider -> SamplerCustomAdvanced -> LTXVSpatioTemporalTiledVAEDecode -> VHS_VideoCombine. The panel is the timeline image guide (start keyframe), the shot motion prompt is the text beat, and an optional motion video segment + IC-LoRA can be added for true V2V/identity. Gate: .ltx_director_smoke_passed.
ltx_director_23.json.notes: Built 2026-08-20, mirroring aether-pipeline-v2 STAGE 3 (V2V Director, LTX Director 2.0) but grounded against the installed ComfyUI-LTXDirector node and the proven 8GB model/VAE stack from video_i2v_ltx_23b_8gb.json. timeline_data/local_prompts/segment_lengths/guide_strength are built per-shot (image start frame + text beat) exactly like the aether example. IC-LoRA is off by default (ic_lora_name=None); a character/style LoRA can be applied via IC_LORA/IC_LORA_STRENGTH. FRAMES patches end_frame+duration_frames together; seconds inputs are constants scaled to the default 97 frames @24fps (4.042s). End-of-clip blur is handled natively by LTXVSpatioTemporalTiledVAEDecode last_frame_fix (true) -- no extra img2img end-frame render.
